result.text:
### Q1
No. The plain JSON file store stays because ops diffs `data/store.json` nightly, and SQLite was rejected.

### Q2
Yes, `src/legacy/`. It is vendored from the old monolith and a platform-team sync job overwrites it every Monday.

### Q3
The signature goes in the JSON body as top-level `sig`: HMAC-SHA256 hex over the body without `sig`, key order preserved, `sig` last. An `X-Signature` header was tried first and failed because the ERP API gateway strips custom `X-` headers.

### Q4
Port 9911 since the October infra move. `config/default.json` still has the outdated 8080.

### Q5
Every new user-facing `message` must be in German, because warehouse packers see it verbatim. The `code` stays English SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE. Old messages stay English; the user said "new only".

### Q6
Through a hardcoded list of holidays in `src/services/holidays.ts`, because there is no internet in the warehouse. It covers only 2026 and 2027.

### Q7
No. The ERP answers 422 to arrays, so each request carries one event object.

### Q8
No new npm dependencies, including dev dependencies, because the security review takes about 6 weeks.

### Q9
No memoization ever existed in this repo, but caching was ruled out as a dead end because QA found stale ETAs on a build that had it. Staging/QA must therefore be running a different build or branch. Pagination of the list endpoint comes later instead.

### Q10
Max 3 attempts with a fixed 30 s delay and no backoff. The ERP dedups by `event_id` only within 2 minutes, so the worst case is about 75 s. Only network errors, timeouts and 5xx are retried, not 4xx.

### Q11
Never log the recipient name, address or phone, for GDPR reasons (flagged by the DPO). Shipment IDs and tracking numbers are fine.

### Q12
Yes, `emits webhook on delivered` in test/events.test.ts (OPS-412), owned by the platform team. If it fails, rerun once and don't fix it.

### Q13
ATP numbers are validated as UPU S10 including the check digit (see `docs/carriers.md`). All other carriers accept any non-empty value, which is deliberately unvalidated. The ATP check also applies to `POST /import` rows.

### Q14
Nothing has been built yet. `fs.watchFile` polling is the approach that works, because `fs.watch` doesn't fire on the Docker bind mount from a Windows host.

### Q15
Yes, `GET /shipments/:id`. The mobile app v2.3 uses a strict schema and the next release is in January, so the response is frozen and a test guards its key set. Only the list endpoint got `eta`.
